sentences.text: ORDER 16.05.2023 This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. S.J. Nanda, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. J.P. Patnaik, learned Government Advocate for the State.
3.

This application has been filed by the State-opposite parties seeking modification of the order dated 16.01.2023 passed in this case and to direct for release of the salary of the officers, which has been held up pursuant to the said order.

4. Mr. J.P. Patnaik, learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposite parties contended that after the order was passed on 16.01.2023, immediate steps have been taken by moving the State Government and after completion of the procedure under the provisions of RFCTLA R&R 2013 Act an amount of Rs. 37,76,86,108/- has been released to the account of Tahasildar-cum-LAO, Chhendipada vide letter dated 01.03.2023 of Superintending Engineer, Minor Irrigation Division Angul.
The notice has been published on 08.04.2023 under Section 11 (1) of 2013 Designation: Asst. Registrar-cum-Sr. Secretary Reason: Authentication Act in two number of Odia newspapers.

Further the preparation of Yadast Location: Orissa High Court,
Cuttack Date: 17-May-2023 10:39:36 is under progress and the process will be completed within a week.
Similarly, compensation of the beneficiaries will be released after completion of statutory period under 2013 Act.
Therefore, he contended that since the process has already commenced and the same is continuing, therefore, the salary of the officers may be released.

5. Mr. S.J. Nanda, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner contended that whether the salary will be stopped or paid to the erring officers, the petitioner is no way concerned with the same,
rather, he is interested to get the compensation amount as has been determined by the competent authority.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and after going through the record, since the petitioner is only interested for compensation amount and the same has already set into motion by the authorities, in that view of the matter, this Court is of the considered view that let the salary of the Collector & District Magistrate, Angul, Land Acquisition Officer, Angul and Chief Development Officer-cum-Executive Officer, Zilla Parishad, Angul be released with a condition that they will not create any hindrance so far as determination of the compensation amount and release of the same to the beneficiaries are concerned.
On the said date, learned counsel for State shall file affidavit that compensation amount has already been paid to the beneficiaries.

(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (B. P. SATAPATHY) JUDGE Indramani Pradhan vs Anu Garg on 16 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146210334/
